description: Return a bounded one-based Yellowstone permutation term using an inclusive candidate cap.

output.encoding: one-based term a(N), or -1 if malformed or any construction step exhausts candidate_cap

contract.recurrence: a(1)=1, a(2)=2, a(3)=3; for n>=4, a(n) is the least positive integer x not in a(1)..a(n-1) with gcd(x,a(n-2))>1 and gcd(x,a(n-1))=1
contract.candidate_scan: For each generated term, test x=1,2,...,candidate_cap in ascending order, inclusive; select the first unused x satisfying both gcd predicates
contract.cap_exhaustion: If one requested prefix step has no qualifying unused candidate at or below candidate_cap, the complete request is invalid and returns -1; a larger cap may succeed
contract.primary_method: Maintain the generated prefix and a used-value table; test the two gcd predicates with Euclid's algorithm
contract.independent_method: Factor each candidate and both preceding terms by trial division; detect a shared factor through prime-factor-set intersection and check prior membership by scanning the prefix
contract.distinction: Unlike EKG, the selection predicate depends on both preceding terms and requires coprimality with the immediately preceding term; it is not a random sequence

complexity.primary_time: At most N*candidate_cap candidate checks; each Euclidean gcd uses O(log(candidate_cap)) divisions, so the profile has bounded O(N*candidate_cap*log(candidate_cap)) time
complexity.primary_space: O(N+candidate_cap) fixed entries for the prefix and used-value table
complexity.independent_time: At most N*candidate_cap trial factorizations with divisors bounded by sqrt(candidate_cap), plus bounded prefix scans
complexity.independent_space: O(N*omega(candidate_cap)) prime factors in the cached prefix factor sets
